pending-clause.answer: The rule matches on 'initial state'. §2002:14.5.2.1.2.1 says the program collating sequences are determined before data is placed in the initial state, word for word as §2023:14.6.2.3.2, and its three activation occasions are the same; what differs (2002 initializes the communication section, 2023 adds the INITIALIZE clause and dynamic tables) is about data, not collating-sequence timing. 'Terminat'/transfer-of-control text (§2002:14.5.10, 14.5.3) is not named by the rule; 14.5.10 item 5 (locale reset at termination implementor-defined) does not touch when LC_COLLATE is read during execution. Scope and the pb64t1_locale_declare evidence at 2002 are unchanged.
